title: Hands-Up Halo v2
description: The same screaming bright supersaw hands-up lead, now driven at 160 BPM with doubled stab density, faster stepped tremolo gating, and snappier filter envelopes so it reads as genuinely quicker and more relentless. Over 32 cycles the square-pumped filter env still blooms, the detune widens, and the room/delay tail opens, then the arc resets.
code:
setcpm(160/4)
stack(
  note("<f4 f4 ab4 c5>*8").s("supersaw")
    .unison(7).detune(sine.slow(23).range(0.18,0.55))
    .tremolosync("<8 16 16 8>/8").tremolodepth(0.88)
    .gain(square.slow(2).range(0.5,1.05))
    .lpf(square.slow(7).range(1000,5600))
    .lpenv(square.slow(16).range(2,8)).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.08)
    .resonance(sine.slow(13).range(10,18)).ftype("ladder")
    .shape(saw.slow(29).range(0.2,0.58)).distort("<0.3 0.5>/8")
    .pan(square.slow(11).range(0.3,0.7))
    .room(sine.slow(32).range(0.25,0.6)).roomsize(4)
    .delay("0.3:0.09375:0.55").delayfb(0.5)
    .gain(0.9)
)
